offering_description.value: Provides management and technology consulting to hospitals, health systems, universities and corporations, helping them improve operations, finance, compliance and growth. Delivered by consultants on project and advisory engagements.

primary_services.value: management consulting; revenue cycle advisory; regulatory compliance consulting; financial advisory; technology implementation; litigation and disputes consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals and health systems, life sciences companies, private universities, corporations and law firms; B2G: public universities and public hospitals

end_markets.value: healthcare; higher education; life sciences; commercial business; legal

revenue_model.value: service fees: consulting fees for advisory and operational engagements; project or contract: fixed-fee and time-based client engagements

value_chain_position.value: service provider: sells consulting expertise and staff time to institutions and companies

geography_served.value: North America: Primarily US clients nationwide, with some clients in Canada and other countries

specialization.value: related lines: healthcare, education, life sciences and commercial consulting practices sharing advisory methods and staff

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: consultants and business development teams selling to client executives

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: client work touches healthcare compliance and student or patient data privacy rules such as HIPAA and FERPA

notes: Segment structure and geographic reach may have changed over time; details reflect general knowledge.
